name: Yagami Toshiki
source:
“Even if it’s just one person in the entire world, I think it’s okay for someone to believe in your talent. That someone is me. I love the way you paint—and your paintings, too.”

Serious, kind, and gentle by nature—reliable and attentive, earning deep trust from those around him. He is Anju’s greatest supporter and closest confidant, naturally looking out for her when she drifts off and always acting alongside her. More than anyone else, he believes in Anju’s talent.

View on romance:

Unwavering—almost to a fault.

[Translated from the [url=https://lamina-pla.net/Keylabox/chara.html]official website[/url]]
